title: Delivery SLA Policy
body: Standard ground shipments carry a 3-business-day delivery SLA from dispatch; expedited lanes carry a 24-hour SLA. Missed SLAs on standard lanes trigger an automatic 10% shipping credit to the customer account.

title: Damaged Goods Claims
body: Damaged goods claims must be filed within 5 business days of delivery with photo evidence. Approved claims are reimbursed at full invoice value within 10 business days; partial damage claims are prorated by affected unit count.

title: Returns Policy
body: Customers may return unopened cases within 30 days of delivery for full credit. Opened or partial cases are accepted only if the mismatch originated on NordLog's fulfillment side, verified against the original pick manifest.

title: MOPP Hazardous Cargo Handling
body: Hazardous cargo shipments require a valid MOPP certification (Movimentação Operacional de Produtos Perigosos) for both vehicle and driver, plus complete NF-e and manifest paperwork, before release from any state tax checkpoint (posto fiscal). Missing or incomplete MOPP documentation is the single most common cause of interstate checkpoint holds.

title: State Checkpoint (Posto Fiscal) Escalation
body: Checkpoint delays of more than 48 hours automatically escalate to the Tax & Regulatory Compliance team, who coordinate directly with the state inspection office. Customers are notified proactively once a shipment crosses the 48-hour threshold.

title: Refund Timeline
body: Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method within 7 business days of claim approval. Refunds tied to fulfillment errors are expedited to 3 business days.

title: Route Congestion Protocol
body: When a lane reports highway or port congestion, dispatch automatically reroutes non-hazardous cargo to the next available route or vessel slot within 72 hours. Hazardous cargo cannot be rerouted without updated checkpoint paperwork for the new route.

title: Exception Handling
body: Orders flagged as Exception must be reviewed by the regional ops lead within 4 business hours. The customer's account manager is notified automatically and must send a status update within 24 hours of the flag being raised.
